title: Live Updates: France Deploys Vast Security Force in Bid to Prevent More Riots
summary_full: As many as 70,000 police and security officers will try to avert the arson and looting that shocked the country last weekend. The interior minister estimated that 35,000 people were out on streets nationwide by midday.
